parsedContent.correctedAnswer: Children need more milk than elderly people because they are in a rapid growth phase and require more calcium, protein, vitamin D and other nutrients per kilogram of body weight for bone and tissue development. Milk is a dense source of these nutrients, making it an efficient way to meet children’s higher per‑kg needs.
